newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain March bond future falls more than 1 point.
newsitem.headline: Spain March bond future falls more than 1 point.

text.p: Spanish March government bond futures fell more than one point on Thursday afternoon to a day's low of 111.70, following other markets lower after unexpectedly robust U.S. data.
But despite perceptions of a stronger U.S. economy following the data, Bonos performed better than many sister markets and the spread to Germany narrowed to below 100 basis points.

The National Association of Purchasing Management's index in December rose to 54.0 percent in December from 52.7 percent in November. The market had anticipated a reading of 51.5 percent and U.S. Treasury bonds fell, leading other markets lower.
